app-title: Hub Formation bu Africa Pioneers - Extérieur
welcome-sub: Bunt bi ngir Dooleel Afrika ci Pi Ecosystem
africa-day: (Ci màggalug Bésub Afrika bu 25e, Application Formation bu Pi Pioneers bii lañu ubbi)
memorial-title: 🕊️ Ci Fatiliku Mbeuguel bu Christina Muzheki Manjengwa
memorial-text:
Hub Formation bii ñu jox na ci sama mag bu bëgg Christina Muzheki Manjengwa bu noppee 8 Ut 2026 te ñu denc ko 11 Ut mu Bésu Heroes bu Zimbabwe.
Sa mbeuguel, sa yëngal ak sa dooleey di gën a dooleel sunu liggéey ngir dooleel Afrika.
Bëccëg ci sunu xol. Noppal ci doole, jigéen.
intro-p1: Pi Network mooy xaalis digital ak projet ecosystem global buñu defar ngir cryptocurrency manna am te am njariñ ci ñépp.
intro-p2: Wuute ak crypto yu cosaan yu laaj ay machine yu seer yu gëstu, Pi Network mooy may nit ñi ordinaire man a bokk direct ci seeni téléphone.
intro-list:
• Tabax ekonomi digital bu duggal ñépp ci lu dul bank
  • Dooleel nit ñi ordinaire ci àddina bépp ak gëstu bu telefon
  • Yokku jëfandikoo bu dëgg ci utilities ak DApps
  • Jàppale jaay-dox bu nit ak nit te wàñi fey
  • Stanford PhDs ñoo ko defar - Dr Nicolas Kokkalis & Dr Chengdiao Fan
  • Lu ëpp 60 Miliyon Pioneers ci àddina
ch1-p2: Jaar 2: Bindu ci Facebook walla Téléphone → Duggal code: CHIGALEX1 → Am 1 Pi récompense
ch1-p3: Gëstu bu Bés bu ne: Dellu ci 24h yu ne te bësal bouton melax ngir yagga gëstu.
ch1-p4: Njuumte yu bari ci luñu wara moytu:
ch1-list2:
• Bul jëfandikoo tur bu feeñ - war na yem ak ID ngir KYC
  • Bul sos compte yu bari - nit kenn compte benn
  • Tek alarme ngir gëstu 24h ju ne ngir sàmm vitess
  • Dugg ci cercle bu kaaraange gannaaw 3 jours ak 5 nit ñu wóor
ch1-list:
• Sos portefeuille Pi ci kàddu
  • Matale 2FA
  • Matale KYC
  • Waajal ngir Mainnet
security-msg: ⚠️ Kàddu gu portefeuille: BUL SËP sa 24 baat yu passphrase! Ekip Pi Core DUSU la laaj!
ch2-p1: Portefeuille Pi yaw mooy banka yaw ci Pi Ecosystem. Mooy yor sa xaalis Pi ci kàddu ci blockchain.
ch2-p2: Naka lañu koy defare: Ubbi Pi Browser → Wallet → Sos Wallet → KOPIA sa 24 baat → Dencale offline ci 2 bérab bu woor.
ch2-p3: Am Pi: Séddoo sa adresse bu mbooloo (tàmbali ci G...). Yónni Pi: Coller adresse bu jotkat bi, duggal lim, confirmer.
ch2-list:
• Bind passphrase ci papier, bul def capture
  • Dencale ci 2 bérab bu woor yu wuute (bul telefon kessé)
  • Essaie ak 1 Pi bala nga yónni xaalis bu mag
  • Xool 4 lettres yu jëkk ak 4 yu mujj yu adresse saa yu ne
ch2a-p1: Pratique: Tambali ci xaalis bu tuuti bu test (1 Pi). Vérifie 4 lettres yu jëkk ak 4 yu mujj yu adresse ñoo yem. Bul coller sa passphrase ci site benn!
ch2a-p2: Exercice Direct: Ci formation bii, dañuy def demo live bu yónni 1 Pi ci beneen pionnier ngir tabax confiance. Fatiliku: Transaction bu Blockchain duñu ko dellu!
ch3-p1: Pi Browser mooy melni Google Play Store ngir Pi. DApps ay application yu tasare ngir jëfandikoo bu dëgg — jaay, njàng, jeux, service yépp ci Pi.
ch3-p2: DApps yu am solo ci Afrika:
ch3-list:
• Pi Chain Mall (PCM) - Marché bu mag ngir Pi
  • WorkforcePool - Liggéey ngir Pioneers
  • CareForPi - Jàppale wérgu yaram
  • Chigalex1 Hub - Formation (Application bii)
  • Ak 100+ yeneen utilités
ch4: CHAPITRE 4 — MAPOFPI & BOOLE BI JAAY KAT
ch4-p1: Gis jaay kat yi nangu Pi ci àddina bépp ci mapofpi.com. Bindu sa jaay kat sa bopp te tambali nangu Pi ngir jënd ak service.
ch4-p2: Naka lañuy bindu jaay kat bi: Demal mapofpi.com → Lëk Pi Wallet → Yokk Jaay kat → Yokk photo, bérab, jënd → Client yi dañu lay gis! Noonu Afrika di jiite adoption bu Pi.
ch5-p1: Valeur Consensus Mondial (GCV) dafay ñaan jëfandikoo bu dëgg. 1 Pi = $314,159 GCV. Valeur bii lañu tabax ci pionniers yi jëfandikoo Pi ci jaay-dox bu dëgg.
ch5-p2: Tekki GCV: GCV du prix bu échange. Dafa moy mouvement ngir aar valeur bu Pi ci jëfandikoo Pi ci consensus bu mag ci sunu jaay-dox. Suñu jëfandikoo Pi ngir yëf yu dëgg ci GCV, dañuy sos demande ak jëfandikoo. Dooleel economie ngir Afrika la.
ch6-p1: Jàngale manuel bu Doris Yin ngir sos jëfandikoo ak yokku gu ecosystem. Seet, jàng, jàngale yeneen — noonu lañuy dooleel Afrika.
ch6-p2: Sa liggéey ni Pioneer bu Afrika: Jàng → Jéema → Jàngal 2 nit → Ñaari ñoñu ñu jàngal 2 yeneen. Noonu lañuy yeg ci 1 Miliyon Afrik yi ñu jàngal! Yëb Whitepaper, jàng, te séddoo xam-xam bés bu ne.
final-msg: Afrika amna chance bu am doole ci jëfandikoo pratique ci Pi Ecosystem. Ñoo Bokke Tabax. Ñoo Bokke Jàngale.
